name: Shapoorji Pallonji The Dualis
summary: Project, developer, Sector 46 location, RERA number, 2 towers / 198 units and the 3/4 BHK carpet sizes are confirmed. Starting price is contested across sources (Rs 5.94 Cr base on brokers up to Rs 7.27 Cr on the developer's site), the RERA land area is 1.74 acres vs our 2 acres, and we omit the RERA completion date of 31 Dec 2031.
